name: open_file
description: Opens a binary file with radare2 for analysis <think>Call this tool before any other one from r2mcp. Use an absolute file_path</think>

file_path.description: Path to the file to open

baddr.description: Optional base address for PIE binaries, same as radare2 -B / -m (for example 0x400000). For raw/headerless files (no ELF/PE magic), this now also creates an explicit io map so the file's content actually appears at this address, matching radare2 CLI's -m behavior

arch.description: Optional asm.arch override (eg. 'arm'), same as radare2 -a. Needed for raw/headerless binaries which cannot be autodetected and would otherwise default to the host arch

bits.description: Optional asm.bits override (eg. 16 for ARM Thumb), same as radare2 -b

cpu.description: Optional asm.cpu override (eg. 'cortex'), same as radare2 -k/-e asm.cpu

name: run_command
description: Executes a raw radare2 command directly

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

name: list_functions
description: Lists all functions discovered during analysis

only_named.description: If true, only list functions with named symbols (excludes functions with numeric suffixes like sym.func.1000016c8)

filter.description: Regular expression to filter the results

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

max_length.description: Maximum number of results to return, -1 for all (default: 50)

name: show_info
description: Displays information about the binary or target process

name: list_symbols
description: Shows all symbols (functions, variables, imports) with addresses

filter.description: Regular expression to filter the results

count.description: If true, return only the number of matching results instead of the full list

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

name: use_decompiler
description: Selects which decompiler backend to use (default: pdc)

name: analyze
description: Runs binary analysis with optional depth level

level.description: Analysis level (0-4, higher is more thorough)

timeout_seconds.description: Optional maximum analysis time in seconds for this call only. Use 0 to disable the timeout.

name: xrefs_to
description: Finds all code references to the specified address

name: decompile_function
description: Show C-like pseudocode of the function in the given address. <think>Use this to inspect the code in a function, do not run multiple times in the same offset</think>

address.description: Address of the function to decompile

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

name: disassemble_function
description: Shows assembly listing of the function at the specified address

address.description: Address of the function to disassemble

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (line number to start from)

page_size.description: Number of lines per page (default: 1000, max: 10000)

name: disassemble
description: Disassembles a specific number of instructions from an address <think>Use this tool to inspect a portion of memory as code without depending on function analysis boundaries. Use this tool when functions are large and you are only interested on few instructions</think>

name: calculate
description: Evaluate a math expression using core->num (r_num_math). Usecases: do proper 64-bit math, resolve addresses for flag names/symbols, and avoid hallucinated results.

name: hexdump
description: Print memory contents in hexdump style at the given address

size.description: Number of bytes to dump (empty string for default size)

name: lookup_symbol
description: Resolve an address to its symbol name
